description: Amplitude Group Identify API on /groupidentify. Amplitude documents api_key and identification as required. identification carries group_type and group_value. HTTP V2 events are vendor/amplitude. User identify is vendor/amplitude-identify.

params.name: api_key
params.description: It is the project API key. Amplitude documents it as required on GET query and POST form.
params.fix_hint: Send `api_key` with the Amplitude project API key.

params.name: identification
params.description: It is a JSON identification object or array. Amplitude documents it as required. Each object carries group_type and group_value.
Identification is an object or array of identification objects.

params.name: group_type
params.description: The vendor documents `group_type` in the request contract.
